info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Atm Network Operation Status-spec
info.description: The ATM Network Operation Status API provides valuable insights into the real-time operational status of ATM networks. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information about the current state of various ATM network operations, ensuring banking institutions can monitor and manage their services efficiently. Typical consumers of this API include banking application developers and operations teams who need to ensure uptime and service availability for customer transactions. By utilizing this API, stakeholders can proactively address issues and enhance the customer experience in ATM banking services.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the current status of the ATM network operations, providing essential information on its availability and performance metrics.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of ATM network operations specific to a channel. It requires a JSON payload that conforms to the specified schema, which defines the structure and expected data types for the request.

200.description: Request completed successfully, providing the current status of the ATM network operations.

ListAtmNetworkOperationStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for a specific GET operation related to ATM network operations. It is expected to be a string type.
